name: Behind-the-Neck Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip, straight arms, and your legs quiet beneath you.
Set your shoulder blades down and brace your core firmly.
Pull your elbows straight downward, guiding your upper body slightly forward so the bar passes cleanly behind your head.
Lower yourself slowly back to a full dead hang without swinging.
tips: Pull only as high as your shoulder mobility allows without craning your head forward.
Control the descent smoothly rather than dropping rapidly into the bottom of the hang.
